# 10 Year Old Sherry Oak Finish

A fine and full-bodied [single malt](https://www.laphroaig.com/). Finished in sherry oak casks to layer aromatic honey onto our famous peat smoke. ​

Unforgettable flavours from our classic 10 Year Old whisky find harmony with the sweetness and complexity of Oloroso sherry to create Laphroaig® 10 Sherry Oak.

## Tasting Notes

_![Tawny and auburn tones.](https://www.laphroaig.com/sites/default/files/styles/original/public/2022-06/LAPHROAIG_website_icon_color-01_0.png.webp?itok=KMiTACf9)_

### Colour

Tawny and auburn tones.

_![Aroma of Laphroaig Scotch Whisky](https://www.laphroaig.com/sites/default/files/styles/original/public/2022-06/LAPHROAIG_website_icon_aroma-01.png.webp?itok=sM8XkwXI)_

### Nose

Bold notes of peat smoke and Manuka honey, with strong cloves, leather, coastal salinity and smoky bacon.

_![Tasting Notes of Laphroaig Scotch Whisky](https://www.laphroaig.com/sites/default/files/styles/original/public/2022-06/LAPHROAIG_website_icon_taste-01.png.webp?itok=Mp9O9tWi)_

### Palate

Sweet and aromatic with rich waxy notes. Followed by toffee, maple syrup, dark chocolate, pine needle and cedar. ​

_![Finish of Laphroaig Scotch Whisky](https://www.laphroaig.com/sites/default/files/styles/original/public/2022-06/LAPHROAIG_website_icon_finish-01.png.webp?itok=SA9oEcWf)_

### Finish

Lingering sweetness and smouldering peat smoke with nuttiness and a hint of brine.

_![Maturation of Laphroaig Scotch Whisky](https://www.laphroaig.com/sites/default/files/styles/original/public/2022-06/LAPHROAIG_website_icon_maturation-01.png.webp?itok=t8Yk1Yjr)_

### Maturation

Aged in ex-Bourbon barrels and European Oloroso sherry oak casks.​

## PEATY SWEETNESS YOU WON'T FORGET​

Finished in European sherry oak casks for a particularly memorable single malt.​ ​ This unique expression begins with the same time-honoured process that goes into our regular 10 Year Old Laphroaig®. After drawing rich character from ex-Bourbon barrels, the spirit then rests in casks previously filled with sweet Oloroso sherry. Each barrel is hand selected to add extra complexity to our quintessential single malt. It’s what layers notes of Manuka honey and grilled bacon onto our renowned flavours of peat smoke and seaweed.

![Sherry Oak Laphroaig bottle on a table with two glasses of drams in hands](https://www.laphroaig.com/sites/default/files/styles/original/public/2024-11/Sherry-Oak-Lifestyle-with-Drams.jpg.webp?itok=gFWtTy9P)

10 Year Old Sherry Oak Finish FAQ

## \#\#\# What is Laphroaig 10 Year Old Sherry Oak Finish?

Laphroaig 10 Year Old Sherry Oak Finish is a full-bodied [Islay single malt Scotch whisky](https://www.laphroaig.com/whiskies) that takes the unmistakable character of our classic 10 Year Old and gives it a richer, sweeter edge. Matured in ex-Bourbon barrels and finished in European Oloroso sherry oak casks, it layers Manuka honey, cloves, toffee, dark chocolate, and nuttiness over Laphroaig’s famous peat smoke.

## \#\#\# What does a sherry cask finish add to Laphroaig’s peat smoke?

A sherry cask finish brings sweetness, depth, and complexity to Laphroaig’s famous peat smoke. In this expression, European sherry oak casks layer aromatic honey and the rich character of Oloroso sherry over the classic 10 Year Old profile. The smoke remains unmistakably Laphroaig, but the finish gives it a fuller, sweeter, and more rounded edge.

## \#\#\# What kind of sherry casks are used for this finish?

Laphroaig 10 Year Old Sherry Oak Finish is finished in European Oloroso sherry oak casks. The whisky first draws smoothness and character from ex-Bourbon barrels, then rests in casks previously filled with sweet Oloroso sherry. Each cask is hand selected to bring extra complexity to the bold, peated soul of Laphroaig.

## \#\#\# How does it compare to the classic Laphroaig 10 Year Old?

Both share the same Islay character, 10-year age statement, and unmistakable Laphroaig peat smoke. The classic Laphroaig [10 Year Scotch](https://www.laphroaig.com/whiskies/10-year-old) is more rugged and direct, with bold smoke, seaweed, and a touch of sweetness. The Sherry Oak Finish starts from that familiar 10 Year Old profile, then rests in European Oloroso sherry oak casks, adding extra sweetness, dried fruit, warming sherry notes, Manuka honey, grilled bacon, and a richer, more complex finish.

## \#\#\# How should you drink Laphroaig 10 Year Old Sherry Oak Finish?

Enjoy Laphroaig 10 Year Old Sherry Cask Finish neat to experience its full balance of peat smoke, sherry sweetness, and lingering brine. A few drops of water can open up notes of Manuka honey, toffee, dark chocolate, and nuttiness, while serving it over ice will soften the intensity slightly. It also brings depth to [Scotch whisky cocktails](https://www.laphroaig.com/whisky-cocktails), from a [Bold Fashioned](https://www.laphroaig.com/whisky-cocktails/bold-fashioned) with maple syrup and chocolate bitters to a [Smoky Espresso Martini](https://www.laphroaig.com/whisky-cocktails/smoky-expresso-martini) with coffee liqueur, espresso, and a touch of sugar syrup. However you choose to enjoy it, let Laphroaig’s character speak for itself.

It also convinces whisky lovers who don't like smoky Islay malts…
